name: Urea (neem-coated)
source: IFFCO Fertiliser's Price List (w.e.f. 1 Jan 2025): 45 kg bag, MRP incl. GST Rs.266.50 -> 5.9222/kg, rounded. Grade per FCO 1985 minimum-N-content specification for urea (46%).

name: DAP
source: IFFCO Fertiliser's Price List (w.e.f. 1 Jan 2025): 50 kg bag, MRP incl. GST Rs.1350 -> 27.00/kg (matches the nationally reported MRP cap, e.g. The Statesman, Mar 2026). Grade 18-46-0 per IFFCO's own product page (iffco.in/en/dap-18-46-0).

name: MOP (Muriate of Potash)
source: Standard grade 0-0-60 per Indian Potash Ltd / industry convention. MOP is under Nutrient-Based Subsidy (subsidy fixed at Rs.1428/t for Rabi 2025-26), not a statutory uniform consumer MRP like urea/DAP -- retail price varies by manufacturer and region, and no single defensible current figure was found. Do not guess; get a dated quote from a specific supplier or state agriculture department before using this in pricing.

name: SSP (Single Superphosphate)
source: Standard grade 0-16-0 (also supplies ~11% S) per FCO 1985 minimum-P-content specification. Not under statutory uniform MRP; market listings found in this pass ranged Rs.105-235/kg across suppliers and regions -- too inconsistent to cite a single number responsibly.

name: NPK 14-35-14
source: Grade name = guaranteed N-P2O5-K2O %% per FCO 1985 nomenclature (definitional, not from a price list). No dated retail price found in this pass.

name: NPK 17-17-17
source: Grade name = guaranteed N-P2O5-K2O %% per FCO 1985 nomenclature (definitional, not from a price list). No dated retail price found in this pass.
